title: "Failed to contact identity server" when deactivating account
body:
A user complained he is getting "unknown errors" in Riot when trying to disable an old account. I checked the logs and there is a relevant stack trace:

```
2019-01-14 12:01:36,512 - synapse.handlers.deactivate_account - 82 - ERROR - POST-860975- Failed to remove threepid from ID server
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.5/site-packages/synapse/handlers/identity.py", line 186, in try_unbind_threepid
    headers,
  File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.5/site-packages/twisted/internet/defer.py", line 1418, in _inlineCallbacks
    result = g.send(result)
  File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.5/site-packages/synapse/http/client.py", line 380, in post_json_get_json
    raise HttpResponseException(response.code, response.phrase, body)
synapse.api.errors.HttpResponseException: 502: b'Proxy Error'

During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.5/site-packages/synapse/handlers/deactivate_account.py", line 76, in deactivate_account
    'address': threepid['address'],
  File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.5/site-packages/twisted/internet/defer.py", line 1416, in _inlineCallbacks
    result = result.throwExceptionIntoGenerator(g)
  File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.5/site-packages/twisted/python/failure.py", line 491, in throwExceptionIntoGenerator
    return g.throw(self.type, self.value, self.tb)
  File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.5/site-packages/synapse/handlers/identity.py", line 195, in try_unbind_threepid
    raise SynapseError(502, "Failed to contact identity server")
synapse.api.errors.SynapseError: 502: Failed to contact identity server
```

The user has a validated email address in `user_threepids`, and very likely left the identity server setting at `vector.im` when logging in to riot. The `trusted_third_party_id_servers` setting in homeserver.yaml lists `matrix.org`, `riot.im`, and `vector.im`. The `users_pending_deactivation` table is empty. The user says their account left all rooms, but they can still log in.

This is synapse 0.34.0.1-0matrix1 debian package running on a debian stable, on matrix.stratum0.org.
